slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a limit on the number of shifts or working days per student per week; its only related question concerned consecutive days or a required day off, which is not the same as a weekly shift/day cap.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether there is a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned to duty.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the scheduling plan — is it to minimize the total weekly labor cost (sum of wage × hours for all students), or is there another goal such as maximizing fairness or minimizing total hours worked?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and named minimizing total weekly labor cost/gross pay.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no limit on the number of shifts or distinct working days per student per week beyond the daily maximums.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a weekly shift/day cap and later stated 'No other restrictions' in READY_TO_MODEL, effectively assuming the hidden U7 constraint does not exist.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no daily limit on the number of distinct students who can be assigned to duty.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a daily distinct-student cap and later stated 'No other restrictions' in READY_TO_MODEL, effectively assuming the hidden U8 constraint does not exist.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL without asking about the P1 hidden constraints on maximum shifts per week and maximum distinct students per day.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the objective and several modeling details, but it missed two P1 hidden constraints—weekly shift/day limits and daily distinct-student caps—and then stopped with those unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
